title: Bootstrapping Euclidean Lattices
summary: We derive spectral identities involving the Laplace spectrum and the integrals of products of eigenfunctions on flat tori and orbifolds. Using semidefinite programming, we derive upper bounds on sums of squares of triple products from these spectral identities, following the approach of the conformal bootstrap. Physically, these upper bounds give constraints on sums of squares of cubic coupling constants in toroidal compactifications of higher-dimensional field theories. For Euclidean lattices, one of the bootstrap bounds leads to an upper bound on the mean square number of minimal vectors…
